title: Workspace general settings (name, slug, logo, timezone)
intent: Users must configure workspace identity, slug for URLs, logo for branding, and timezone for scheduling.
acceptance: Slug is unique and immutable after creation
anti_patterns: Slug editable after creation breaks all URLs
Logo upload without validation causes crashes
Timezone change orphans scheduled events
Name change loses audit trail
manual_simulation: Edit name and verify in header
Change timezone and verify event times
incentive: Workspace identity is foundational to all operations

title: Workspace members panel: invite, roles, deactivate
intent: Admins must manage workspace membership with granular role control (admin/member/guest).
acceptance: Invite by email with bulk support
Join audit log shows who invited whom and when
anti_patterns: No confirmation before deactivating
Invite without validation allows duplicates
Role change silent (no notification to user)
Deleted members still visible in old projects
incentive: Access control is core to workspace security

title: Workspace billing: plan selection, seat usage, payment method
intent: Admins track seat usage and manage paid plan upgrades.
acceptance: Current plan shows seat limit and usage
Upgrade flow shows new plan limits
anti_patterns: Plan downgrade silently removes features (no dry-run)
Payment method stored in plaintext
No invoice history or export
Billing alerts arrive too late
manual_simulation: View current plan and seat usage
Upgrade from free to pro (preview changes)
incentive: Revenue and compliance depend on accurate billing

title: Workspace integrations panel: webhooks, Slack, GitHub, Jira sync
intent: Users connect external services and manage API tokens/webhooks.
acceptance: View integration logs (last 100 calls, timestamps, errors)
anti_patterns: Webhook URL exposed in logs
No way to test webhook before saving
Revoked token still accepted for 5 minutes
Integration logs don't show failures
manual_simulation: Create API token and copy to clipboard
incentive: Integrations unlock workflow automation and third-party sync

title: Workspace export: backup all projects, issues, and members
intent: Users must be able to export workspace data for compliance and migration.
acceptance: Export includes all issues with comments/attachments
Export includes member list and role history
anti_patterns: Export missing nested comments or attachments
Export role history resets to current state only
No progress indicator for large workspaces
Download link never expires (security risk)
manual_simulation: Try to access link after 24h (should fail)
incentive: Data portability and GDPR compliance

title: Project general settings: name, identifier, lead, description
intent: Users configure project metadata, unique identifier, and project lead.
acceptance: Identifier is immutable after creation (used in issue keys)
Description renders markdown with image support
anti_patterns: Identifier editable after creation (breaks issue URLs)
Description doesn't render markdown
Lead change doesn't update default assignee for new issues
Name change loses rename audit
manual_simulation: Set lead and verify default assignee
Edit description with ![image](url) and verify render
incentive: Project identity must be stable for all issue references

title: Project members: invite, roles, set default assignee
intent: Users assign roles per project and set default assignee for new issues.
acceptance: Remove member removes all assignments (with prompt)
anti_patterns: Remove member without confirming open assignments
Default assignee not applied to new issues
Guest role still edits project settings
Member deletion doesn't update audit log
manual_simulation: Remove member with open tasks (should prompt)
incentive: Project-level access control enables delegation

title: Project features: enable/disable cycles, modules, views, pages, intake
intent: Users enable/disable features per project to reduce UI clutter.
anti_patterns: Disable feature but nav link still appears
Disabling cycles doesn't hide cycle selector in issue detail
No warning when disabling feature with active data
Feature toggle doesn't persist
manual_simulation: Verify nav no longer shows Cycles
Disable pages with existing pages (should warn)
incentive: Feature controls reduce complexity for small teams

title: States editor: create states, group into backlog/unstarted/started/completed/cancelled
intent: Users customize workflow states with semantic grouping.
acceptance: Create custom state in any group
anti_patterns: Delete state without checking open issues
Move all issues to default state silently
State color picker doesn't match UI palette
No way to see how many issues use a state before delete
manual_simulation: Create custom state 'In Code Review' in started group
Set as default for new issues
Try to delete state with 5 open issues (should warn)
incentive: Custom states express team workflow semantics

title: Labels editor: create, color, parent hierarchy, archive
intent: Users create and organize labels with optional parent-child hierarchy.
anti_patterns: Delete label permanently (breaks audit trail)
Parent label deleted without moving children
Label color too close to background (A11y fail)
No way to see label usage before archiving
Reorder doesn't persist
incentive: Label hierarchy enables tag-based organization

title: Estimates: T-shirt / Fibonacci / linear / custom points
intent: Users select and customize estimation system per project.
acceptance: Switch estimate type (system-wide change with preview)
T-shirt: XS, S, M, L, XL
Show count of estimated vs unestimated issues
anti_patterns: Switch estimate type, orphan old estimates
No preview before switching (data loss risk)
Custom points don't sort numerically
Estimate field still visible if disabled
incentive: Flexible estimates support different planning styles

title: Cycles settings: default duration, start day of week
intent: Users set cycle/sprint defaults (2 weeks, 1 month, custom).
acceptance: Start day of week: Monday, Sunday, custom
Show upcoming cycle list with dates
anti_patterns: Duration change doesn't apply to future cycles
Auto-create cycles without prompt
Start day change orphans active cycle
No way to see next 12 cycles before setting
manual_simulation: Set cycle duration to 2 weeks, start on Monday
incentive: Cycle defaults reduce manual planning overhead

title: Automations rule list: view, create, enable/disable, delete
intent: Users see all automation rules and toggle them on/off.
acceptance: Show rule name, trigger, action, status
anti_patterns: Delete rule without confirmation
Disable rule doesn't actually stop execution
No feedback when rule triggers
Rule list doesn't show last execution time
incentive: Automation governance is critical for reliability

title: Rule builder: select trigger, condition, action
intent: Users create rules with trigger → condition → action.
acceptance: Trigger dropdown: issue.created, state_changed, cycle_started, etc.
Action dropdown: change_state, assign, add_label, etc.
Preview rule execution on sample issue
anti_patterns: Rule editor doesn't validate before save
Trigger/condition mismatch (e.g., cycle_started but check issue field)
No preview of rule behavior
Action silently fails (no error feedback)
manual_simulation: Create rule: trigger = state_changed to 'Done', action = archive
Create rule: trigger = cycle_ended, action = close_state
Try to save rule with invalid condition (should error)
Save and verify rule executes correctly
incentive: Rule builder UX directly impacts user adoption

title: Auto-archive: archive issues completed N months ago
intent: Automatically archive stale completed issues.
acceptance: Archive issues in 'Done' or similar completed state
Audit log shows archived issues and reason
anti_patterns: Archive issues still in active sprints
No preview of which issues will be archived
Archive without audit trail
Auto-archive runs too frequently (performance)
manual_simulation: Create completed issue dated 4 months ago
incentive: Auto-archive keeps projects tidy and performant

title: Empty automations panel when no rules exist
intent: Guide user to create first automation rule.
anti_patterns: Empty state shows with 0 rules (no helpful guidance)
CTA button not prominent
No examples of what rules can do
Help text is too technical
incentive: First-run experience drives feature adoption

title: Custom field types: text, number, date, select, multi-select, user, url
intent: Users create custom fields to extend issue data model.
acceptance: Field types: text (string), number (int), date (ISO), select (enum), multi-select (enum[]), user (IUserLite), url (string)
Create field with name and type
anti_patterns: Custom field created but not shown on issue detail
Required field doesn't block issue creation
Default value not applied to existing issues
Field type change orphans old data
manual_simulation: Create issue and fill custom fields
incentive: Custom fields enable domain-specific data collection

title: Custom field display on task detail, quick-add, and forms
intent: Custom fields are visible and editable in all issue forms.
acceptance: Custom fields appear on issue detail sidebar
Custom fields appear on quick-add form
Edit custom field inline on detail panel
Validation enforced (required, type check, enum bounds)
Change history tracked in activity log
anti_patterns: Custom field not visible on issue detail
Custom field not in quick-add form
No validation on custom field edit
No audit trail for custom field changes
manual_simulation: Create issue and fill in custom 'Client Name'
Quick-add another issue with custom fields
Verify activity log shows custom field changes
incentive: Custom field UX determines adoption

title: Backfill custom fields on existing issues
intent: When creating required custom field, backfill defaults on existing issues.
acceptance: Create required custom field with default
System backfills all existing issues with default
Completed issues can still be updated
anti_patterns: Required custom field doesn't backfill (issues become invalid)
No progress indicator during backfill
Backfill fails silently
No way to rollback backfill if default is wrong
incentive: Backfill enables safe required field addition

title: Task templates: preset fields, description, custom fields
intent: Users create templates for recurring issue types (bug, feature, task).
acceptance: Create template with name and description
anti_patterns: Template variables silently fail (no substitution)
Template doesn't include all custom fields
No way to see variable list when creating template
Template applied but doesn't override defaults
manual_simulation: Create 'Bug Report' template with priority=High, state=Backlog
incentive: Templates accelerate issue creation for common patterns

title: Quick-add form: apply template, fill in required fields only
intent: Template selection in quick-add reduces form friction.
acceptance: Submit creates issue with all template + user-entered data
anti_patterns: Template selection doesn't pre-fill form
No distinction between required and optional fields
Collapsing optional fields loses data on re-expand
Template pre-fill is overwritten by defaults
manual_simulation: Submit and verify issue created with template + user data
incentive: Template quick-add boosts issue creation velocity

title: Empty templates panel when no templates exist
intent: Guide user to create first template.
anti_patterns: Empty state shown but no guidance
Preset templates not available
Can't quickly adopt preset template
incentive: Preset templates reduce template creation friction

title: Jira importer: connect Jira Cloud, preview issues, map fields, import
intent: Users import issues, users, and epics from Jira Cloud.
acceptance: Input: Jira Cloud hostname, email, API token, project key
Validate credentials and list Jira issues
Preview: show issue count, label count, state count, user count
Dry-run: show what will be imported
Map Jira issue types → Fulcrum task types
Map Jira users → invite or map to workspace users
Import: create issues with descriptions, comments, attachments
anti_patterns: No credential validation (fails mid-import)
Import without preview (silent data loss)
Jira issue types don't map to anything
User mapping allows duplicate invites
Attachments not downloaded
incentive: Jira import enables migration from incumbent tool

title: GitHub importer: select repo, import issues, map users
intent: Users import issues from GitHub repository.
acceptance: Preview: issue count, label count, collaborators
Map GitHub users → invite or map
Import: create issues with descriptions, comments, PR links
anti_patterns: OAuth token stored in plaintext
No repo preview (import surprises user)
PR links broken after import
Archived issues imported as active
manual_simulation: Import and verify PR links work
incentive: GitHub import serves developer teams

title: CSV importer: upload, map columns, preview, import
intent: Users import issues from CSV (generic spreadsheet source).
acceptance: Manual column mapping: CSV col → Fulcrum field
Import: create issues, handle errors per row
anti_patterns: Column detection doesn't work (user must map all)
No preview before import (silent failures)
Import fails mid-process with no rollback
Large file upload hangs (no progress)
manual_simulation: View import report (X created, Y skipped)
incentive: CSV import handles ad-hoc data sources

title: Importer dry-run: preview sample issues before committing
intent: Show user exactly what will be imported before it's created.
acceptance: Dry-run shows first 10 issues as they will appear
Show field mapping results (what Jira field → Fulcrum field)
Total count of issues to be created
anti_patterns: Dry-run doesn't show actual field values (only field names)
Dry-run is inaccurate (actual import differs)
User mapping not shown in dry-run
No way to go back and fix mapping before import
incentive: Dry-run prevents import disasters (data loss, duplication)
